source: Confirmed by Séverine from Equinet-provided responses

creator.a2_consequence: No Creator object is required for A2. If another specialist later requires a Creator object, Unitalk must propose a separate schema for Mustad/Equinet approval.

campaign.a2_consequence: A2 may later reference the standard Campaign object when an approved mapping requires campaign provenance; A2 must not propose a duplicate Campaign custom object.

authority_boundaries: Super Admin status does not by itself approve A2 business outputs, CRM writes, provider spend, pilot activation or production acceptance.
Mustad HubSpot is a service or placeholder account and cannot serve as a human approver.
The named CRM/business owners may approve HubSpot properties, objects and workflows as confirmed, but the A2 business reviewer and backup reviewer remain to be confirmed.
OAuth approver identification does not mean that OAuth has been granted or connected.
Every sensitive action still requires the applicable recorded approval and verified connector scope.
remaining_gaps: Named A2 business reviewer and backup reviewer
Action-level approval matrix for A2 records and field changes
Actual OAuth grant, scopes and read-only connection
Creator schema decision for any future non-A2 specialist that requires it
